# Home Accounting v0.4.3

Patch release for safer curated transaction CSV staging and synchronized version metadata.

## Changes

- Added transaction CSV normalization that matches accounts/categories, infers transaction types, applies merchant/category suggestions, and marks each staged row as ready or needing attention.
- Added deterministic CSV reference hashes and structured import batch notes with filename, file hash, row count, upload timestamp, and staging mode.
- Updated the import screen to show ready versus needs-attention counts and jump directly into the newly staged batch review.
- Synced `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, changelog, release notes, git commit, and tag around version `0.4.3`.
- Added a tag-triggered GitHub Release workflow so future pushed version tags publish release notes from `.github/releases/v<version>.md`.

## Validation

- Version metadata: `package.json` and `package-lock.json` both report `0.4.3`.
- Smoke test: `npm run smoke:local` passed against a temporary local app process.
